summary: End-to-end testing of Hanabi hobby tracker - 7/7 backend pytest tests pass and all critical frontend flows verified (login, dashboard stats, pre-seeded categories, add-title, settings/themes, API key generation & revoke, inbox panel).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~635 lines - approaching threshold; could be split into routers/auth.py, routers/titles.py, routers/extension.py for maintainability.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI - prefer lifespan context manager.
set_cookie uses secure=False - acceptable in preview but should be True in production (likely behind https). Consider env-controlled flag.
create_category does not enforce unique slug per user (no uniqueness check) - duplicate names create duplicate slugs.
metadata search swallows exceptions returning []; consider logging/returning 503 distinctly for diagnostics.
API key response includes raw key only on create (good); however list endpoint exposes prefix - acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test user (test_*@example.com), TEST_ category, TEST_ titles, TEST_ API key - cleanups attempted in tests. One residual UI title 'TEST_UI Weak Hero' may remain in admin K-Dramas (manual delete fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is pytest-style; ADMIN credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Frontend testids verified: sidebar/nav-dashboard/nav-inbox/nav-settings/nav-category-{slug}/add-category-btn/open-add-title/add-title-input/add-title-submit/theme-picker-{slug}/create-apikey/revealed-key/apikey-row-{id}/revoke-apikey-{id}/hanabi-inbox-panel. Login redirects to '/' (not '/dashboard') - root route renders Dashboard. 14 themes confirmed.
rca of the issue: n/a - all features working as expected. Single test fix during run: EmailStr Pydantic validator rejects .test TLD as reserved -> switched test fixture to @example.com.
